description: Zone inundabile is a dataset listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire.rowater.ro. Floodplains in Romania are the extension (area) of potentially floodplains in major river beds reported under the Directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on flood risk assessment and management (2007/60/EC), known as the Floods Directive. They signify the temporary water cover of land not normally covered with water. Coverage: RO. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2014-10-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
